query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, up.pageKey, up.canAccess, up.canEdit
FROM users u
JOIN userPermissions up ON up.userId = u.id
WHERE up.pageKey = 'fin_employees' AND up.canAccess = 1
ORDER BY u.name;
